sections.title: AI Inventory Features That Matter for Asian Businesses
sections.content: **Demand forecasting for Asian seasons:** Chinese New Year, Songkran, Hari Raya, Diwali, 11.11, 12.12, and Lunar New Year each create massive demand spikes. Zoho Inventory's Zia AI can learn these patterns from your historical data and adjust reorder points automatically. A Thai supplement seller reduced stockouts by 60% just by feeding two years of historical data into Zia. **Multi-warehouse across borders:** If you hold inventory in Singapore (for fast SG delivery), Johor (for MY customers), and a third-party warehouse in Bangkok, you need tools that understand border costs. Cin7 Core and Zoho both support multi-warehouse inventory with different valuation methods for each location. **Cost of goods in multiple currencies:** A Vietnam-based seller importing raw materials from China, manufacturing in Binh Duong, and selling on Lazada Vietnam needs COGS tracking across CNY, VND, and USD. Zoho handles this natively at $19/mo; Cin7 does it at $249/mo. **Low stock = lost sales:** In Asian e-commerce, 11.11 and 12.12 generate 30-50% of annual revenue for many sellers. AI tools predict these spikes and recommend pre-ordering inventory 45-60 days ahead.

sections.title: Regional Setup Guide for Asian Sellers & Manufacturers
sections.content: **Singapore e-commerce seller:** Stack = Zoho Inventory ($19/mo) + Shopee/Lazada plug-ins + Ninja Van/J&T Express integration. AI handles demand forecasting for CNY, 11.11, and 12.12. Total cost: $19-39/mo. **Malaysian small manufacturer:** Katana ($99/mo) for production planning + inFlow for raw material inventory. If you make-to-order (batik, furniture, food products), Katana's AI production scheduling is worth the premium. **Thai restaurant group / F&B:** inFlow Inventory ($89/mo) with batch tracking for perishable ingredients + AI reorder points based on daily sales data from LINE MAN or GrabFood. **Indonesia e-commerce (TikTok Shop):** Google Sheets + Julius AI ($20/mo) for bootstrapping. Upgrade to Zoho Inventory when you hit 100+ orders/month. Most Indonesian sellers start on TikTok Shop and expand to Shopee/Tokopedia later. **Vietnam manufacturer:** Katana for BOM and production scheduling. Most Vietnamese factories are B2B/OEM, so manufacturing-focused tools work better than retail inventory tools.

**Our Pick:** For most Asian e-commerce sellers, **Zoho Inventory at $19/mo** is the sweet spot — Shopee/Lazada integration, AI forecasting, multi-currency support, and affordable pricing. Small manufacturers should choose **Katana ($99/mo)** for production scheduling. Bootstrappers: start with **Google Sheets + Julius AI ($20/mo)** and upgrade when you hit 50+ orders per month.

questions.q: Can these tools integrate with Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop?
questions.a: Yes, partially. Zoho Inventory has plug-ins for Shopee and Lazada. TikTok Shop integration is newer — most sellers use manual CSV export/import for TikTok Shop data in 2026. Native integrations are expected by late 2026.

questions.q: How accurate is AI demand forecasting for Asian markets?
questions.a: With 12+ months of historical data, AI forecasting achieves 85-95% accuracy for established products. Accuracy drops for new products (60-70%). Tools like Katana and Cin7 improve over time as they learn your specific seasonal patterns.

questions.q: What's the best setup for a multi-country warehouse operation?
questions.a: Cin7 Core ($249/mo) is purpose-built for multi-country inventory. Zoho Inventory Professional ($29/mo) works for 2-3 warehouses in SE Asia. For more than 3 warehouses or cross-border fulfillment, Cin7 justifies its cost.

questions.q: Can AI handle F&B/perishable inventory differently from retail?
questions.a: Yes. inFlow Inventory has batch tracking and expiry date alerts. Katana's production scheduling can incorporate ingredient shelf life. Zoho supports batch and expiry tracking on higher tiers.

questions.q: How do I handle the 11.11 / 12.12 / CNY demand spikes with AI?
questions.a: Most tools with forecasting features identify seasonal patterns automatically. Feed at least one full year of daily sales data. Zoho Zia and Katana both highlight anomaly days (like 11.11) and adjust reorder forecasts accordingly.
